name: Instanced Voxel Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that visualizes a sparse voxel grid by generating a single unit cube mesh and drawing it multiple times at different positions using OpenGL instanced rendering, reducing memory overhead compared to storing full geometry for every voxel.
summary: Instanced Voxel Rendering visualizes sparse voxel grids by drawing a single unit cube mesh multiple times via GPU instancing, reducing memory overhead compared to storing full geometry for every voxel.
